figurative_meaning_en: In a very quick or hasty manner
similar_in_english: In the blink of an eye
At the drop of a hat
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঝাঁ ঝাঁ করে কাজটা সারিয়ে ফেললাম।
সে ঝাঁ ঝাঁ করে চলে গেল ঘর থেকে।
example_sentences_in_english: I finished the work in a jiffy.
She left the room in a flash.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in colloquial Bengali to denote rapidity.
